chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mansur, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
ai.seo_question: What three things continue to reward a person after death in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to define the enduring spiritual legacy (*Sadaqah Jariyah*) that transcends death. The narration emphasizes that while worldly possessions cease to follow the deceased, continuous reward is generated through active charity, the propagation of beneficial knowledge or practices, and the intercessory prayers of righteous offspring, highlighting the Shia emphasis on familial piety and communal benefit.
